name: TIC 350333806

text.card: A red giant 1,101 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.91 solar masses and 11.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,557 K at its surface.
